notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Restart Level Update -> Option to choose if you want to restart the whole level or just from the last
checkpoint
[*] Fixed the bug with the shadow platform, where sometimes it doesn't move the player with it
[*] Fixed the bug where mode selection button can be pressed multiple times
[*] Fixed the error when the item is being traded while one of the characters died
[*] Small Performance improvements
[*] Minor Quality of Life changes for levels:
	- Zone 2 Level 2
	- Zone 2 Level 8
	- Zone 3 Level 4
	- Zone 4 Level 4
	- Zone 4 Level 10
	- Zone 5 Level 8
	- Zone 5 Level 11
[/list]
